passages.title: Employee handbook excerpt
passages.body:
SECTION 4: REMOTE WORK POLICY

Employees who have worked at Tolland Industries for at least six months may request to work remotely up to two days per week. Requests must be submitted to the employee's direct supervisor at least two weeks before the proposed start date. Approval depends on the nature of the employee's duties and the needs of the department.

Remote workers must be available by phone and e-mail during regular business hours (9 A.M. to 5 P.M.) and must attend any in-person meetings scheduled by their team. The company will provide a laptop and secure network access, but employees are responsible for their own internet connection. Remote work privileges may be withdrawn if performance falls below expectations.

passages.title: Press release
passages.body:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Veritas Software Announces Acquisition of DataBridge

TORONTO, March 11 — Veritas Software, a leading provider of business analytics tools, today announced that it has agreed to acquire DataBridge, a Vancouver-based company specializing in cloud storage. The transaction, valued at $240 million, is expected to be completed by the end of June, subject to regulatory approval.

"This acquisition will allow us to offer our customers a complete solution, from data storage to analysis," said Veritas CEO Naomi Patel. DataBridge's 180 employees will continue to work in Vancouver, and its founder, Luis Ortega, will join Veritas as vice president of product development.

passages.title: Email: training session
passages.body:
To: All sales staff
From: Rita Gomez, Human Resources
Date: January 20
Subject: Customer Communication Workshop

Dear colleagues,

Human Resources is pleased to announce a half-day workshop on customer communication, to be held on Thursday, February 6, from 1:00 to 5:00 P.M. in Conference Room B. The session will be led by Dr. Amir Haddad, an expert in negotiation and conflict resolution. Topics will include handling difficult phone calls, writing clear follow-up e-mails and building long-term client trust.

Space is limited to twenty participants, so please register by January 30 using the online form on the intranet. Participants will receive a certificate of completion and a copy of Dr. Haddad's book.

Best regards,
Rita Gomez

passages.title: Memo: parking
passages.body:
MEMO
To: All employees at the Eastgate Office Park
From: Building Management
Date: August 14
Re: Parking garage closure

Please note that Level B of the parking garage will be closed from August 26 to September 6 for repainting and repairs. During this period, drivers who normally use Level B are asked to park on Levels C or D, or in the temporary lot on Cedar Avenue, which is a five-minute walk from the main entrance. A shuttle service will run every ten minutes from 7:30 to 9:30 A.M. and from 4:30 to 6:30 P.M.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.

passages.title: Article: bike-sharing
passages.body:
BIKE-SHARING SCHEME EXPANDS TO SUBURBS

After a successful two-year trial in the city center, the Riverton bike-sharing program will extend to six suburban neighborhoods this spring, the city council announced Tuesday. Residents will be able to rent one of 1,200 new bicycles from 80 stations, many located near train and bus stops.

The pilot program recorded more than 400,000 trips and reduced short car journeys by an estimated nine percent, according to council spokesperson Janet Cole. "We want cycling to be a practical choice for everyday travel, not just a leisure activity," she said. Annual memberships will cost $60, and single rides will be $2 for the first 30 minutes.
